approaches.title: Hash map with index-based doubly linked list
approaches.summary: Stores cache entries in a vector, maps keys to entry indices, and tracks least- and most-recent entries with doubly linked-list pointers. `get` and `put` move entries to the MRU position and evict the LRU entry; later revisions fix edge cases and remove debugging output.

revisions.shortChangeSummary: Initial index-based hashmap and doubly linked-list implementation for LRU operations. Marked wrong; it does not correctly handle existing keys and some list updates.
